label: Delete parent-only rows from CentroCostos
summary: Elimina de "CentroCostos" las filas referenciadas como principal (ya migradas a "centro_costos_principal")

precheck.description: ensure parent rows exist and every one is backed by centro_costos_principal
precheck.sql: SELECT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 AS "one" FROM "public"."CentroCostos" p   WHERE p."CodCentroCto" IS NOT NULL AND p."CodCentroCto" <> ''     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."CentroCostos" cc WHERE cc."CodCentroCtoPrincipal" = p."CodCentroCto")     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."centro_costos_principal" m WHERE m.centro_costo_principal = p."CodCentroCto") ) AS "result"

execute.sql: DELETE FROM "public"."CentroCostos" p WHERE p."CodCentroCto" IS NOT NULL AND p."CodCentroCto" <> ''   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."CentroCostos" cc WHERE cc."CodCentroCtoPrincipal" = p."CodCentroCto")   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."centro_costos_principal" m WHERE m.centro_costo_principal = p."CodCentroCto")

postcheck.description: verify no rows referenced as principal remain
postcheck.sql: SELECT NOT EXISTS (   SELECT 1 FROM "public"."CentroCostos" p   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "public"."CentroCostos" cc WHERE cc."CodCentroCtoPrincipal" = p."CodCentroCto") ) AS "result"
